transcript: I have breaking news that has been provided directly to the David Pakman Show. Allegedly, Mitch McConnell has been unconscious in the hospital for the last 3 weeks. This would directly undercut the claim that he is continuing to recover as has been stated numerous times. This would directly undercut claims from some that they have been in touch with Mitch McConnell and he said that he is doing well. This is what sources are telling me directly. Now, if you didn't know, on June 14th, Senator Mitch McConnell was found unconscious. Even that detail was only revealed weeks after he went missing entering a hospital. We weren't told which one it is for a condition that was not disclosed. Many people have been asking, where is he? This has drawn significant attention to the situation. Many have been questioning whether he is even alive. There were incorrect assessments made about there would be an effort to cover up his death because uh Republicans don't want Democratic Governor Andy Beshear to appoint a replacement. But, that's not the way Kentucky law works. Andy Beshear would not appoint a replacement. There would be a special election. Now, understand the degree to which if this report is true that I received, that he has been unconscious for weeks, some would call it a coma, others would say unconscious. Um this means that we have been deliberately lied to. 3 hours ago, the office of Mitch McConnell offered no update into the state of his condition even though it has been weeks since he has been hospitalized. Trusted sources of the David Pakman Show have told us that he has been unconscious this entire time, which would explain the pickle that we are in. If he is alive, the only way to vacate his seat is to resign. How do you resign if you are unconscious? The only alternative would be to be expelled by a 2/3 vote in the Senate, which doesn't appear as though it is likely to happen. So, it seems as though, as long as Mitch McConnell is alive, the seat will remain his, and we will likely not receive answers from his team. There are multiple issues here. There is the gerontocracy of the United States. There is the fact that if our sources are right that he has been unconscious for weeks, claims that he's recovering are by definition false. There is the very strange uh news that his wife, Elaine Chao, just 3 days after Mitch McConnell's hospitalization, was in China meeting with the Chinese vice president. Strange timing. It's all extraordinarily weird. And it would now put a different light on all of the statements made by McConnell's office, unless they didn't even know that McConnell was unconscious, at which point we are really getting into increasingly unlikely situations. Our sources telling us Mitch McConnell has been unconscious for weeks. If true, what does this now mean about the future of that position? What does this now mean about what has to happen in the US Senate?
